    parser.add_argument("template", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("rows", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(args.rows.open()))
    for letter in render_all(args.template.read_text(), rows):
        print(letter)
    return 0
